programIndicators.description: Number of hypertension patients currently flagged as overdue and pending a recall call, who have a phone number on file. Candidate tracker-derived replacement for the aggregate-only data element 'HTN - Contactable patients that are overdue at the start of the month' (iRgb6hOfzEk). Built on the assumption (per project instruction) that a nightly SQL job maintains the tracked entity attribute 'HTN - Patient follow-up status' (rgeuEnAI0nj) by setting it to OVERDUE_PENDING_CALL once a patient's scheduled visit date has passed with no visit recorded, mirroring the simpledotorg/dhis2-hypertension-package nightly-trigger pattern referenced in this project's CLAUDE.md. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: a tracked entity attribute holds only its CURRENT value, not a history -- this PI reads 'overdue right now' at analytics run time, not a true point-in-time snapshot of 'overdue as of the first of the reporting month.' If the nightly job runs daily and a patient's status can flip between OVERDUE_PENDING_CALL and CALLED within the same month, a month-end analytics run will undercount patients who were overdue at the start of the month but got called later in that same month. This is an inherent limitation of modeling state via a TEA rather than an event/history record, not a mistake in this PI -- flagging for a decision on whether to also log status-change events if month-start snapshots matter for reporting.

programIndicators.description: Unique HTN patients who received a recall call during the reporting month and had a Hypertension & Diabetes visit event within 15 days afterward. Candidate tracker-derived replacement for the aggregate-only data element 'HTN - Overdue patients called that returned to care within 15 days' (xZ07XCMF85u). Excludes died/transferred/12-month-LTFU patients, matching the data element's description. By design this checks the nearest matched visit event to the call (a short, high-frequency recency check, not tolerant of a long gap to the next visit) -- confirmed as the intended behavior, not a boundary-resolution bug, for a repeatable stage.

programIndicators.description: Number of hypertension patients under care prescribed an anti-hypertensive medication (Amlodipine, Hydrochlorothiazide, Losartan, or Telmisartan) recorded at a visit in the reporting month. Candidate tracker-derived replacement for the aggregate-only data element 'HTN - # Treatment with anti-hypertensive medication' (OhgHrhV8MGZ). Scope note: the free-text field 'HTN - Other hypertension medication' cannot be reliably parsed for drug class and is excluded -- if patients are commonly on an agent captured only in that free-text field, this PI will undercount. Unlike WHO's package (4 separate drug-class PIs), this is a single combined 'any anti-hypertensive' count, matching this toolkit's existing aggregate indicator design.
programIndicators.name: HTN - Treatment with anti-hypertensive medication (#)

Depending on the location, you may need to take additional steps to document consent in accordance with local laws.
